GET /api/assistant/playlists/model-statu.reason: ADR-023 input v4 discloses request-matched vocabulary meanings for candidate manual tags. The disclosure version advances to v3; shape, candidate limit and output/playback contracts remain unchanged. The web Assistant consumes this endpoint; Baton does not.

POST /api/assistant/playlists/model-sugg.reason: Live playlist model jobs now require disclosure v3 and explicit consent for the additional vocabulary context. Old v2 consent is deliberately rejected before enqueueing. The browser advances with the server; no native client or playback wire change is required.

GET /api/auth/sessions#responses.reason: ADR-024 adds the independent session_id. The legacy token_prefix field and delete path remain as aliases for the complete non-secret management ID; partial bearer-token prefixes are no longer accepted. Schema 11 deliberately revokes legacy sessions once. Cookies, auth requirements, timestamps, logout scope and native playback DTOs remain unchanged. Settings now uses session_id.

DELETE /api/library/cleanup/sources/{sou.reason: Catalog credential removal is an authenticated extension added after the frozen v1 reference.

GET /api/assistant/library-tags/model-st.reason: ADR-025 adds bounded-run limits, selected/deferred counts, conservative reservation units, Batch availability and pending Batch identity. Existing status fields remain; disclosure v12 describes slots, reliability and optional provider file processing.

GET /api/assistant/library-tags#paramete.reason: The supported tag review filters evolved with the local and model evidence views; existing optional-filter defaults remain supported.

GET /api/assistant/library-tags#response.reason: ADR-022 adds optional review_summary counts across matching tracks before review-state filtering and pagination. Existing page fields and authentication are unchanged; older browser responses may omit the summary. Output clients do not consume this administrative endpoint.

POST /api/assistant/library-tags/query#r.reason: ADR-022 adds the same optional review_summary to the model-only review page; counts include all review states and pages within the requested scope. Existing page fields and authentication remain unchanged.

GET /api/library/cleanup/sources#operati.reason: Catalog source availability and encrypted credential status are an authenticated extension.

GET /api/readiness#operation.reason: Readiness separates dependency readiness from liveness for the Rust runtime.

POST /api/assistant/library-tags/model-j.reason: ADR-025 adds defaulted limits and processing mode to explicit mood-tagging jobs. Standard mode remains the default; new inference requires disclosure v12 and current quality gates. Old disclosure consent is intentionally rejected. No native playback DTO changes.

POST /api/assistant/library-tags/model-p.reason: ADR-025 adds explicit limits, selected/deferred counts, conservative reservations and Batch availability/status. Existing scope and context fields remain. The browser uses server-owned counts before requesting consent.

POST /api/library/cleanup/enrichment-job.reason: Catalog enrichment creates bounded review-only jobs as an authenticated extension.

PUT /api/library/cleanup/sources/{source.reason: Catalog keys use encrypted storage through an authenticated operator endpoint.
Catalog source policy is an authenticated operator setting.

POST /api/assistant/library-tags/model-p.reason: ADR-025 adds defaulted run limits and processing mode to the read-only local planner. Existing callers retain bounded standard defaults; planning performs no provider inference.

GET /api/assistant/library-tags/model-ba.reason: ADR-025 adds an authenticated metadata-only Batch status endpoint. It excludes frozen track inputs and exposes durable provider IDs/results for review and recovery; no playback or Baton contract changes.

POST /api/assistant/library-tags/model-b.reason: ADR-025 adds authenticated explicit collect/cancel/recovery actions for already-recorded batches. Recovery checks run and input-file identity. Actions cannot start new paid inference; abandonment requires an explicit acknowledgement in the browser.
